clips.title: The story
paras: South Tide's Run is the lonely southwestern coastline of Silverpine Forest, stretching along the cold waters of the Great Sea. Flanking the forested interior, these damp sands and surf serve as the southern complement to North Tide's Run.

Stretching along the southwestern edge of Silverpine Forest, South Tide's Run forms a desolate boundary between the woods and the Great Sea. Unlike the protected eastern roads that lead down toward the Greymane Wall, this open shore takes the brunt of the western tides, serving as a bleak coastal wilderness largely untouched by the settlements inland.
